name: 06-abend-discgrp
description: A posted transaction with category 9999 has no disclosure-group rate, not even under DEFAULT: CBACT04C's 1200-A-GET-DEFAULT-INT-RATE gets status 23 and abends (CEE3ABD, RC 12). POSTTRAN accepts the transaction (it never validates the category) and creates the TCATBAL row. The job stops after INTCALC; COMBTRAN and TRANREPT are NOT RUN; the always-on capture unloads still run so the diff can see the partially updated files.
